method: Manual check, one annotator (the authors), of every quantitative or comparative claim in each distinct explanation against the supplied prompt evidence. Responses were byte-identical across the five seeds for every variant, so each distinct explanation is audited once. List-valued statements count as one claim; comparative statements as another. Explanations are capped at 400 characters by the decoding grammar.
